facts.fact: GTAPE handed the National Elections Commission the updated electoral rolls of 966,152 registered voters in physical and electronic versions for the 30 August 2026 referendum.
GTAPE's director-general said the 966,152 voters ready for the 23 November 2025 elections are in GTAPE's databases (Bancos de dados), up from 928,187 the year before.

note: The document only reports the Council of Ministers approving a legal regime for computerising civil registration; no system, procurement, pilot or rollout is stated.
Company-creation platform page; says nothing of a voters' roll.
Names an electoral database and a planned roll update, not stated to be a digital or biometric register in service; integration with the civil register is only an aim.
